Maintain subdued gray/brown painted material and existing soft highlights, with no new reflective grain or black margins.

source_description: Preserve the same complete 64 by 64 square painted atlas. Keep exactly ONE original red star-shaped painted mark in the upper-left olive field, with the identical source contour, size, position, subdued red palette and soft shading. Keep the original two broad soft gray-olive horizontal washes underneath it, the single rounded olive-gray lower-left wash, and the original curved gray field with its soft dark border in the upper-right. Keep the irregular dim mottled gray pigment in the right/bottom field at its original spatial frequency, irregular phase and local contrast; this is existing painterly pigment, not a regular checker grid or physically counted woven fibers. Preserve every faint olive patch and band at the right edge, and the large original opaque black round area lower-right plus the small dim olive marks to its left. No new emblem, no new star points, seams, threads, cells, shiny rim, scratch pattern or hardware; do not make the original material photographic leather or steel.
